Ferland Mendy, Raul Asencio and Rodrygo are out injured, while Vinícius is unavailable through suspension. That list thins both the back line, with two centre-back options missing, and the forward line, where the absences of Rodrygo and Vinícius leave Mourinho short of attacking width. Denzel Dumfries, who has started twice in the matches used here, looks the likeliest bench option to step into a vacated role if needed. [...] Ahead of the UEFA Champions League meeting between Real Madrid and RB Leipzig on Wednesday 21 October 2026, the predicted lineups for both sides are shaped largely by a lengthy injury and suspension list rather than tactical surprise. With four Real Madrid players and four RB Leipzig players already ruled out, the selection question before kickoff is less about formation than about who fills the gaps left behind. The expected XIs below are built from each side’s most recent matches, not an [...] Christoph Baumgartner, Marc Guiu and Assan Ouedraogo are out injured, while Leopold Zingerle is unavailable through suspension. The absences bite hardest in midfield and attack, with two central midfield options and a forward missing from Demichelis’s selection. Rocco Reitz, who has started once across the matches used here, is the bench player best placed to provide cover in midfield.

data.title: Real Madrid vs. RB Leipzig prediction, lineups, odds and bet builder tips for Champions League match | Sporting News
data.content:
Mourinho will have the services of Vinicius again after he sat out the win over Sevilla through suspension.
 He is set to be part of a very attacking lineup that will be led by Mbappe, who is looking to make it 12 in as many games this season.
 Arda Guler was key to the win over Roma and his set-pieces could be crucial again here.

### RB Leipzig predicted lineup to play Real Madrid

Vandevoordt (GK) — Baku, Orban, Lukeba, Raum — Banzuzi, El Aynaoui — Gruda, Nkunku, Nusa — Romulo [...] Having hit a remarkable 15 in 11 games last season in the competition, he has two in two this campaign.

It would be a surprise if he didn't add at least one to that tally.

## Real Madrid vs. RB Leipziglineups: Predicted starting XIs

Here's how we think the two teams will line up at the Bernabeu.

### Real Madrid predicted lineup to play RB Leipzig

Courtois (GK) — Valverde, Konate, Huijsen, Carreras — Guler, Tchouameni — Diomande, Bellingham, Vinicius — Mbappe [...] Real Madrid will be expected to make it three from three in the Champions League when they host RB Leipzig at the Santiago Bernabeu.

On his return to Rome last week, Jose Mourinho saw his side complete a remarkable late comeback, sealing a 4-3 win with three goals in the final seven minutes.

They followed it up with another four goals against Sevilla at the weekend, two of which were scored by Kylian Mbappe, who has returned from injury in style.
